title: Validate the dossier and export the eCTD package
walkthrough:
The right-hand side rail carries the cards for this flow. At the top sits the "Readiness" card. It shows a heading "Readiness" with a status chip reading "● READY TO FILE" or "● BLOCKED", then a line "3 of 5 filing steps complete (60% of the tracked filing checklist)". Below that a caption reads "Checked against ANDS Studio structural eCTD validator v1.0 — structural completeness, not HC's official eValidator," followed by a "Rule catalogue" button. A progress bar, a compact eCTD primer, and a "How is 60% measured?" expander sit under it; the step tiles and, when blocked, a "The single thing standing between you and ready:" panel with a "Do this next →" button. When ready, a green notice reads "Everything checks out — your package is ready to transmit to Health Canada."
Next is the "Draft completeness check" card. On its face is a status chip — "● NO STRUCTURAL ISSUES" or "● 3 issue(s)" — plus the profile name and version inline: "ANDS Studio structural eCTD validator v1.0 (structural; not HC eValidator)" with a one-line disclaimer. Two ghost buttons sit under it: "What this does / does NOT check" and "Rule catalogue (CA-E/CA-W ids)"; the catalogue lists every rule id (e.g. CA-E-1001) with its family, severity and plain description. Findings are listed below, each prefixed with a rule id and an "error"/"warning" chip; only the first 5 errors and 3 warnings show, with "Show all N findings" and "+N more warning(s)" toggles. The technical sub-check and report exports are collapsed behind a quiet "Technical check & report" expander that reveals a "Run technical check (PDF header/encryption)" button (shows "Checking…" while running) and "Download report (CSV)" / "(JSON)" buttons.
Below is the "Sequences" card, with a "working: 0001" note. Each sequence row shows its number, a purpose chip (Response, Supplement, Annual notification, Initial), a "N leaf(s)" count, an "● ACTIVE" badge or "Make active" button, and an "Export" button. Lifecycle operator chips (e.g. "2× new", "1× replace") appear per sequence. A "New sequence" button opens a purpose dropdown, a note field (placeholder "Note (e.g. screening deficiency SDN-1)"), and "Create & make active" / "Cancel".
Clicking "Export" downloads the package if the check passes. If it does not, export fails closed: an in-card "Export blocked — sequence 0000" panel opens and cannot be dismissed by collapsing. It states the reason, the profile checked against, and up to 8 findings by rule id. To proceed you must type a reason into the "To export anyway, type a reason (recorded to the audit trail):" field (placeholder "e.g. internal QA review only — not for transmission"); only then does "Export anyway (override)" enable, or you "Cancel". If validation could not run, export is likewise blocked.
